syncSegmentsEn.text: The white egret in the field lacks nothing
The lilies on the hilltop give off their fragrance in spring
Almighty God gives true blessings day by day
He makes the earth sprout and bear fruit, a sign of His loving care
The Lord’s blessings abound like sand on the shore
His grace and steadfast love endure through all generations
I will raise my hands to worship Him and sing with joy
I will praise and bless His name forever without ceasing
